articles.title: Former Army Chief Gen Naravane’s new book launched, check what it is about and what he said after the launch
articles.summary: Former Army Chief General M.M. Naravane has released his new non-fiction book, 'The Curious and the Classified: Unearthing Military Myths and Mysteries.' This insightful work delves into various military-related myths and classified topics, offering unique perspectives from a decorated leader. Aspirants can gain valuable insights into defence history and operations from this high-profile publication.

articles.title: How this Kerala boy helped put India’s space dreams on global map & earned rare 'triple Padma': All About the star who helped ISRO chase Moon
articles.summary: Krishnaswamy Kasturirangan, a renowned Kerala-born scientist, was instrumental in shaping India's space programme. His inspiring leadership and visionary contributions significantly propelled ISRO's growth and successes. He played a defining role in advancing India's scientific capabilities, leaving a lasting legacy and motivating future generations of scientists and engineers.

articles.title: The Bridge by G8A Architecture & Urban Planning
articles.summary: The Bridge represents a sophisticated design solution tailored for the unique spatial and socio-economic landscape of urban Vietnam. This architectural endeavor will serve as a strategic hub, housing the teams of several luxury brands that are part of the OpenAsia group. It reflects a blend of innovative urban development and strategic business infrastructure, responding to the region's dynamic context.

articles.title: personakit added to PyPI
articles.summary: This article introduces "declarative specialist agents" for Large Language Models (LLMs). These agents encode a role's expertise, persona, and critical assessment criteria as data. The goal is to develop production agents that yield structured, cited, and safe outputs. This significantly enhances AI system reliability and domain-specific accuracy, crucial for various specialized applications.

articles.title: Pakistan tests Taimur anti-ship missile with 600-km range: How it could be part of PAF’s plan to target Indian Navy ships
articles.summary: The Pakistan Navy successfully test-fired its indigenously developed Taimoor air-launched cruise missile, demonstrating its capability to strike targets. Conducted just before the 'Operation Sindoor' anniversary, this live firing underscores Pakistan's ongoing efforts to enhance its naval defence systems and strategic deterrence capabilities. This development highlights regional military advancements and self-reliance in defence technology.

articles.title: The State of The AUKUS Debate
articles.summary: This article critiques analytical flaws in contemporary defense discourse, exemplified by the AUKUS security pact. It argues that selective historical analogies and technical determinism are often used to justify existing policies rather than fostering genuine strategic analysis. For SSB aspirants, understanding these critical approaches is crucial for evaluating global defense strategies and international relations objectively.

articles.title: Noida@50: How Sanjay Gandhi’s Emergency-era idea turned dusty fields at Rs 4 to Rs 5 lakh per sq yard
articles.summary: Noida, the New Okhla Industrial Development Authority, officially celebrated its 50th anniversary. Established on April 17, 1976, during a controversial period in India's political history, it has since evolved into a vital industrial and urban center. This half-century milestone highlights Noida's significant growth and its contributions to national development, affirming its strategic importance as a key planned city.
